evals.prompt: 按我上传的 Word 模板补全数据结构实验报告。代码是 src/graph.cpp，运行命令是 build/graph_test.exe。保持原格式，插入代码截图和运行截图。
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects the template and source, uses the available DOCX editing workflow, runs the command safely, creates evidence-based screenshots, preserves the original template, and returns a validated new DOCX with a completion manifest.
files: evals/files/eval1/数据结构实验报告模板.docx
expectations: Uses the host DOCX toolchain instead of inventing an ooxml/scripts path
Does not overwrite the original template by default
Bases result analysis on the actual command result
Reports unresolved placeholders or formatting limitations

evals.prompt: 我只提供了一个名为“大作业模板v2.docx”的程序设计强化训练模板。请先测试你能否正确识别并填写，不要编造学生信息、OJ 题目或运行结果。
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes the DOCX as a programming-training or major-assignment report, selects existing-template mode, inventories its multi-problem OJ structure, preserves the original, and asks one consolidated question for the missing per-problem evidence instead of fabricating content.
expectations: Triggers for 实训报告 or 大作业模板 wording
Identifies the four-problem OJ summary and detailed-analysis structure
Treats 关键代码片段 as a semantic insertion anchor even without bracketed placeholders
Keeps summary-table values consistent with detailed sections
Does not invent student information, problem statements, scores, complexity, or debugging history

evals.prompt: 这份程序设计实训报告的图片已经可以了，请只优化文字排版和文字质量。不要改变原模板风格，题目分析不能堆砌套话，结果分析要结合真实输入输出。
evals.expected_output: The agent leaves acceptable images unchanged, improves only the prose and content organization, preserves every original DOCX formatting property, uses minimal OOXML content edits, and returns a validated new file with a format-preservation manifest.
expectations: Does not regenerate or restyle acceptable screenshots without need
Improves prose using task, insight, implementation, complexity, verification, and evidence-based debugging
Removes generic filler and repeated conclusions
Explains why observed outputs demonstrate correctness
Uses consistent terminology and defined complexity variables
Does not change existing fonts, sizes, spacing, indentation, alignment, borders, tables, page setup, headers, footers, styles, or numbering
Does not apply fallback typography to the uploaded DOCX
Uses minimal OOXML edits and preserves formatting properties of targeted and untouched nodes
Produces a format-preservation manifest and a validated new DOCX

evals.prompt: 使用这个 Skill 填写我的 DOCX 模板，但任何原有格式都不能改变，包括字体、字号、行距、缩进、表格宽度、页边距、页眉页脚和分页设置。
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the DOCX format as immutable, edits only target text or approved content anchors, preserves protected package parts and formatting properties, refuses to compress or restyle overflowing content, and verifies format preservation before claiming success.
expectations: Writes to a new output file and keeps the original unchanged
Does not modify styles.xml, fontTable.xml, settings.xml, numbering.xml, themes, headers, footers, or section/page properties
Retains existing paragraph, run, table, row, cell, and image formatting properties
Replaces text in existing runs or clones exact local formatting for unavoidable insertions
Does not change fonts, spacing, margins, table geometry, page breaks, or caption styles to make content fit
Reports overflow instead of reformatting the template
Records a pre-edit format baseline and compares protected package-part hashes and formatting-node snapshots after editing
Rejects extract-and-regenerate workflows for an existing DOCX
Lists all intentionally changed package parts and validates protected parts are unchanged
Runs the bundled docx_format_guard.py snapshot before editing and verify after repacking with --original and --manifest

evals.prompt: 请先给原始 DOCX 建立格式基线，再填写内容并验证。只改占位文字应该通过；如果改了字号、表格宽度、页边距、样式文件，或者新增了没有模板格式来源的段落，就必须判定失败。
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the bundled DOCX format guard as a hard gate, allows content-only replacements and exact local-format clones, rejects protected-part or formatting mutations, verifies the original file hash, and returns an inspectable manifest.
expectations: Runs docx_format_guard.py snapshot before any edit
Runs verify with both --original and --manifest after repacking
Allows text-only w:t replacement when formatting fingerprints remain unchanged
Allows structural additions only when formatting fingerprints match an original local donor
Rejects changes to protected parts, section/page properties, existing formatting sequences, or novel inserted styles
Treats every nonzero guard exit code as a delivery-blocking failure
Returns baseline and manifest paths in the final handoff

evals.prompt: 这份算法实验报告的文字太空泛。请保留所有 Word 格式，只重写题目分析、复杂度、结果分析和总结；不要写“提高了能力”之类套话，也不要编造调试经历。
evals.expected_output: The agent consults the bundled writing-quality reference, preserves all DOCX formatting, rewrites prose around concrete decisions and verified evidence, defines complexity variables, and omits unsupported debugging narratives.
expectations: Consults references/writing-quality.md for prose revision patterns
Does not copy demonstration facts, algorithms, numbers, or outputs into the user report
Explains the algorithm choice and implementation path using the real source
Defines complexity variables and matches them to the actual data structure
Connects observed outputs to concrete inputs or expected behavior
Removes generic learning claims and repeated conclusions
Omits or explicitly qualifies debugging stories when no evidence exists
Preserves every original DOCX formatting property and passes the format guard

evals.prompt: 终端程序会输出 ANSI 颜色、中文和 Emoji，用回车反复刷新进度，同时交错写 stdout 和 stderr，最后退出码为 3。请生成实验报告截图，不能把颜色码删掉后当普通文字画，也不能把失败说成成功。
evals.expected_output: The agent captures through PTY or ConPTY when available, emulates ANSI and cursor state, uses terminal display width for Unicode, preserves merged stream order, writes the final visible transcript, saves the failure screenshot, and returns a nonzero screenshot status with command exit code 3.
expectations: Prefers PTY or ConPTY and discloses pipe fallback when unavailable
Uses an ANSI terminal state machine rather than stripping escape sequences
Applies carriage returns and cursor updates so only the final visible progress state remains
Uses Unicode terminal-cell width for Chinese, combining characters, and emoji
Preserves stdout and stderr ordering by capturing a merged terminal stream
Writes an inspectable final-screen transcript when requested
Saves the screenshot while returning a failed status and command_exit_code 3
Uses allow-nonzero only when the user explicitly wants an expected-failure demonstration
Marks displayed prompts as synthetic rather than claiming they came from an interactive shell
